entries.reason: Generated by the :awake:core:text:generateGraphemeBreakTable task (GenerateGraphemeBreakTableTask in build-logic) from GraphemeBreakProperty.txt, emoji/emoji-data.txt and DerivedCoreProperties.txt: the grapheme break properties are Unicode data, not code, and no Kotlin Multiplatform library covering every Core target ships them.
Unicode's own conformance cases for UAX #29 grapheme clusters, copied unchanged so GraphemeBreakConformanceTest checks the iterator against them.

The official prebuilt Basis Universal transcoder's Emscripten loader, copied unchanged, so the browser can transcode KTX2 textures to the GPU's block format (#1211). BinomialLLC publishes no npm package, and the small Khronos transcoders handle UASTC only, not ETC1S. Its SHA-256 is checked at build time by the verifyBasisTranscoder task, which fails the build on a mismatch.
